data.summary:
Certified Project Manager (PMP, CSM) with 15+ years of experience leading cross- functional teams and delivering complex technical solutions.
Proven track record in successfully deploying machine learning and data analytics projects, with a focus on implementing Agile methodologies to drive process improvements and enhance team performance.
Skilled in bridging business and technology by applying Generative AI, data analytics, and
automation to improve efficiency, decision-making, and customer satisfaction.
    RECENT PROJECTS
RAG Pipeline Development – Directed the design and implementation of Retrieval- Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that delivered real-time Q&A capabilities, significantly improving user satisfaction and response accuracy.
Customer Churn Prediction Model – Managed end-to-end delivery of an ML-based customer churn prediction model for a telecom client by analyzing large datasets, providing actionable retention insights, and driving measurable business outcomes.
LLM-Based Sentiment Analysis – Managed the development of an LLM-powered sentiment analysis system that classified customer feedback in real time, enabling faster strategy execution and improved customer satisfaction.
Python-Based Automation Workflows – Led the development of automated data workflows for preprocessing, ingestion, and transformation, streamlining RAG and LLM fine-tuning pipelines.
Power BI S GenAI Dashboards – Architected self-service Power BI dashboards with GenAI-powered narratives and automated alerts via Power Automate, accelerating executive decision-making and business responsiveness.
AI Performance S Adoption Dashboards – Managed the publication of AI adoption metrics, model performance dashboards, and iterative improvements to ensure continuous business value delivery.
Project Management Professional (PMP)
Certified Scrum Master – CSM, Infosys Global Agile Certification
Skillsoft Advanced ML, Deep Learning S GenAI Specialization
Generative AI, ChatGPT for Business Transformation
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate - PL 300
Power Automate Microsoft certification
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certification by AIG Pro Excellence
ITIL V3 foundation certified by EXIN certification body
ISO/IEC 20000:2011 Lead Implementer and Auditor certification by DNV
ISO9001:2015 Internal Lead Auditor certification by BSI
SCAMPI-A trained as an ATM Member for CMMI-DEV v1.3
“Introduction to CMMI-DEV v1.3” training by authorized SEI trainer (QAI)
CURRENT WORK EXPERIENCEHCL Technologies Ltd.Hyderabad

raw_sections.experience:
Project Manager	 Oct 2021 – Present
Lead end-to-end project delivery of AI/ML and GenAI solutions using Agile methodologies ensuring on time and within- budget execution.
Manage project scopes, risks, resources, and stakeholder communication for AI/ML implementations.
Translate complex AI technical requirements into actionable project plans aligned with business goals.
Implement Agile practices (Scrum, Kanban), facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and backlog management.
Serve as a bridge between technical teams (data scientists, ML engineers, developers) and business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment.
Oversee MLOps pipelines, ensuring CI/CD/CT processes for scalable and reliable model deployment.
Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure project continuity and success.
Collaborate with clients to define success metrics, KPIs, and ROI for AI/ML projects.
Communicate project status, risks, and dependencies to senior stakeholders, driving proactive issue resolution.
Managed stakeholder engagement, sprint execution, and resource planning utilizing Jira and Microsoft Project.
Drove process improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma methodologies, achieving significant reductions in operational costs and improving project efficiency.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate business intelligence insights into continuous improvement frameworks.
Managed the development and deployment of interactive Power BI dashboards to provide critical business insights for leadership's strategic decision-making.
Mindtree Ltd.	Bengaluru
Technical Lead	 May 2020 – Apr 2021
Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives) to ensure alignment and continuous delivery of value.
Established, monitored, and reported on SLAs and KPIs, ensuring program objectives were met and maintaining transparency with stakeholders through regular reporting.
Led the integration of data from multiple sources (SQL, Excel, cloud platforms) to create comprehensive Power BI dashboards for a unified view of business performance.
Directed the creation of Python-based scripts that streamlined data preparation from multiple sources for BI dashboards and ML models.
Set up, monitored and reported on SLAs and KPIs for customers, ensuring alignment with program objectives and fostering transparency through regular updates.
Mentored and guided team members, promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Infosys Ltd.	 Gurugram
Quality Assurance Manager	 Jan 2016 – May 2020
Acted as an Agile coach, leading the successful implementation of Agile, DevOps, and Kanban methodologies across the organization, which improved team productivity and project delivery times.
Led the implementation of Agile, DevOps and Kanban methodologies; acted as an Agile coach guiding delivery team best practices on the methodologies
Conducted ML adoption workshops and built proof-of-concept predictive models (using Python, scikit-learn) to demonstrate defect prediction and process optimization.
Managed large-scale programs covering quality certifications, internal/external audits, and process compliance.
Directed the end-to-end implementation of ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 20000:2011 standards for a client organization.
Collaborated closely with diverse stakeholders including customers, delivery units from multiple BUs, CCAT and external audit teams, and vendors to drive alignment and execution.
Datamatics Global Services Ltd.	Mumbai
Consultant	 Jun 2014 – Jan 2016
Facilitated Agile and Kanban ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) to identify and remove data-related impediments, ensuring smooth project delivery and continuous improvement.
Served as an Appraisal Team Member for the CMMI Dev V1.3 Level 4 appraisal, focusing on data and process maturity to ensure high-quality, data-driven outcomes.
Performed statistical metrics analysis using Monte Carlo simulations and exploratory data modeling to identify causal factors, supporting CMMI high-maturity practices and data-driven decision-making.
Utilized Minitab to conduct statistical analysis, process variation studies, and hypothesis testing, providing key insights for data-driven quality and process improvements.
Annik Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.	Gurugram
Consultant Process Quality	 Mar 2012 – Jun 2014
Championed Six Sigma and Lean methodologies across the organization to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Contributed to the CMMI Level 3 implementation and the management of ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 frameworks.
Participated in the implementation and management of ISO 9001:2008 (Quality Management System) and ISO 27001:2011 (Information Security Management System) frameworks.
Nagarro Software Pvt. Ltd.	 Gurugram
Executive IT	 Jun 2010 – Mar 2012
Assisted in the implementation of ISO27001:2005 and CMMI DEV v1.3 L4 and L5 framework
Participated in process audits for various process areas and tracking findings to closure with Project Managers
